title: Skip to the Dunes | 5BR Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Skip to the Dunes is a luxury 5BR Grayton Beach home in a gated community with private beach access and 2 pools. This 30A rental sleeps 12. Reserve today!
description_expanded: Description: Skip to the Dunes by Royal Destinations Location: The Preserve at Grayton Beach Address: 283 Morgan's Trail Details: Imagine stepping into the ultimate 30A getaway as soon as you book your stay at Skip to the Dunes in The Preserve at Grayton Beach. This incredible home, with 5 spacious bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, offers luxurious accommodations for up to 12 guests. You’ll enjoy private deeded beach access and the exclusive amenities of this upscale gated community, making your stay truly unforgettable. At Skip to the Dunes, you're not just staying in a beautiful home- you're experiencing the best that Grayton Beach has to offer. The Preserve at Grayton Beach boasts 2 private pools, 2 tennis courts, and an unparalleled sense of security and comfort in a high-end gated environment. Enjoy the natural beauty of the area with a serene, community deeded beach access, just steps away from your doorstep. This private, gated access takes you through beautiful scenery, culminating in stunning views over sand dunes and the emerald waters of the Gulf. Whether you’re relaxing around the house, biking to nearby shops and restaurants, or taking a short walk to the beach, Skip to the Dunes is the perfect spot for your next unforgettable vacation. Let this exceptional home be your gateway to the ultimate 30A escape! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Public Beach Access: 0.8 Miles (5 Minute Bike Ride) -Private Deeded Beach Access For Preserve At Grayton Community -*Access to 2 Community Pools -Parking Spaces: 3 Spaces in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 4. Rooftop Seating for 4 -Wet bar and refrigerator on 3rd floor -Coffee Maker Available -Propane Grill Available (Propane Provided) -Community Tennis Court Access *Larger pool located at the West end of the community is only heated during Spring Break, Thanksgiving and Christmas. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps 12 5 Bedrooms / 4.5 Bathrooms First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath, Balcony -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area / Half Bath Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath, Balcony -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Private Bath, Balcony -Bedroom 4: Two Twin/Twin Bunks with Private Bath, Balcony -Laundry Room Third Floor: -Loft with Full Bed -Tower Seating and Views of the Gulf of Mexico -Kitchenette Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *No Personal Golf Carts or Trailers Allowed. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
